verdict.rationale: Factory documents real-time monitoring of active missions: tracking worker progress (status) and viewing detailed execution logs live, which covers watching what a running agent is doing. The Sessions API supports managing session lifecycle. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on real-time status for ordinary (non-mission) CLI/App sessions, explicit definition of the status states shown, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can watch what a running agent is doing in real time, including its current status

citations.quote: Monitor active missions, track worker progress, and view detailed execution logs in real time.
Create and drive Droid sessions: manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages.
